authority.environment: Codex delegated agent in the shared typst-crystalline worktree

baseline_identity.identity_rule: Only the complete ratified vanilla identity may support a normative parity verdict; a version string is insufficient.

oracle_policy.positive_self_pair_rule: A Preserved oracle proves retention of a complete declared public observable by the harness; it does not preassign crystalline parity.
oracle_policy.measurement_rule: Expected public values absent from the frozen inputs must be captured from the authoritative vanilla before comparison and must not be inferred from the current product.
oracle_policy.language_boundary: Compare semantics, syntax, morphology and public diagnostics; exclude clocks, scheduling, internal representation and raw rendered bytes unless the probe explicitly declares a public structural witness.

execution_contract.determinism_requirement: All four executions of a case yield byte-identical canonically sorted semantic payloads.
execution_contract.process_isolation_rule: Every focal invocation identified below runs in its own process; one diagnostic may not suppress a later case.

backlog_oracle.owner_rule: Every implementation-queue entry classified PRODUCT_GAP names exactly one existing owner L0 before it can be emitted; non-product limitations are not silently assigned as product work.

gate_requirements.positive_rule: Every complete positive self-pair returns Preserved with no reason code.
gate_requirements.opaque_rule: Every opaque fixture returns Unknown with exactly its predeclared reason code; Unknown remains fail-closed.
gate_requirements.identity_rule: No observation is complete without profile, exact feature vector, binary SHA-256 and input identity.
gate_requirements.determinism_rule: Two repetitions in canonical and reverse physical order produce identical canonical payloads.

limitations: These are authored fixtures only; no oracle, product, runner, harness or enumerator was executed.
The exact S11 transition values and strings are not stated in the frozen inputs and therefore remain authoritative measurements to freeze before comparison.
S07 and S11 explicitly preserve Unknown(PARSER_UNSUPPORTED) when their required observer or binding is unavailable.
